question: For each migration status, show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (in MB) for instances involved in **active migrations**, considering only migrations that are not deleted and only instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache entry. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT
    m.status AS migration_status,
    AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb,
    VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance_memory_mb,
    STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS stddev_memory_mb
FROM migrations m
JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
WHERE m.deleted = 0
  AND m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM instance_info_caches iic
    WHERE iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
      AND iic.deleted = 0
  )
GROUP BY m.status;
